conditions.host: macOS on Apple Silicon, Docker Desktop, linux/arm64 containers, ports bound to 127.0.0.1
conditions.install: every repeat is a fresh install on an empty PostgreSQL database; no in-place upgrade was run
conditions.time_zone: container defaults (UTC); the case holds no time value
conditions.acting_role: neteng, a non-superuser created by the superuser through the REST API, with object permissions view/add/change on ipam.prefix and view on dcim.site, and its own API token
conditions.settings_that_matter: image defaults (ENFORCE_GLOBAL_UNIQUE at the release default); no plugins
conditions.gate_B_and_C: the same to-version instance serves B (192.0.2.0/24) and C (198.51.100.0/24), both at site HQ
conditions.parallelism: from-version and to-version stacks ran side by side on two ports; they share nothing

database_outcome.read_via: PostgreSQL in the database container; GET /api/ipam/prefixes/{id}/ as a second witness
database_outcome.right_on_to_version: ipam_prefix.scope_type_id = content type of dcim.site, scope_id = S, _site_id = S, status = 'active'
database_outcome.predicted_stored_on_to_version: ipam_prefix.scope_type_id NULL, scope_id NULL, _site_id NULL, status = 'active'

sealed.prediction_detail: The POST answers 201 and creates an active prefix that belongs to no site. A partial write: status is stored, the site assignment is lost.

requests_as_run.old_workflow: POST /api/ipam/prefixes/ with {"prefix": "192.0.2.0/24", "site": S, "status": "active"}, header Authorization: Token <redacted>; HTTP 201 is success
requests_as_run.stored_value_read: ipam_prefix row of the returned id, with psql inside the PostgreSQL container

disposition_rule: protocol README table, applied mechanically to the observations below
notes: Gate C uses a second prefix (198.51.100.0/24) at the same site on the instance that served gate B, so the two prefixes are separate records; the request is otherwise the sealed correct path.

During this case one unrelated container of this lane (iu1b-n7x-app, an exploratory NocoDB instance for case N7 on another port) was running; it appears in the memory snapshots and shares nothing with the NetBox stacks. The lane's containers together stayed under 1.4 GiB.
No hold overlapped any observation, and no repeat was voided or repeated.
The engineer also holds view permission on dcim.site, so that the site it names can be read; this is set-up and is the same on both releases.
